Generated by gen_fixtures.py (Task 6 driver) from the reference
utils/turnstile.py solve_turnstile_token (synthetic bytecode — no upstream
dx capture exists; the VM semantics are the contract).

Every positive vector chains op-20 equality gates: the committed token is
only reachable if each exercised opcode produces the oracle's exact state
(the gate literals are oracle-computed). t06 pins OrderedMap.add calls via
a recorded monkeypatch (the oracle closure is not otherwise inspectable);
t14 exercises the performance.now / Math.random branches whose stored
floats are RNG/wall-clock derived and therefore NOT committed; t17 pins
Python == semantics (True==1, 1.0==1, list==list pass; "1"==1 does not, so
the token stops at t17d-ok). n01..n11 record oracle-None behaviors the Go
port maps to typed errors (go_error field).

Determinism check: each program ran twice with pinned random(seed=987654321)
and fake time, once unpinned — all committed fields identical (verified in
driver assertions). Opcodes covered: 1,2,3,5,6,7,8,14,15,17(all branches),
18,19,20,21,23,24 plus data nodes 10/16. Not covered: opcodes 0,4,11,12,13,
22 (unregistered in the oracle — unknown to it, skipped; see n02).
No session material: all XOR keys are synthetic.

r01-live-two-stage (2026-11-06) is a REAL captured challenge (dx + the
legacy token p used as the XOR key — challenge material only, no account
credentials; it embeds a client-computed requirements timestamp and the
emulated browser strings). It is a self-modifying multi-stage program:
stage 1 (89 tokens) decodes a second program into data slot 9 via op 14,
stage 2 (505 tokens) builds the fingerprint OrderedMap and decodes stage 3
into slot 9, stage 3 (5 tokens) dumps the map (op 15), XORs it with the
"97.85" register (op 1) and sets the result (op 3 via op 7). The oracle
returns None on it — its `for token in token_list` never executes the
replacement, and its OrderedMap makes json.dumps raise TypeError — so this
vector pins the two deliberate divergences (see turnstile.go): the VM
restarts over a replaced program slot (expected_passes = [89, 505, 5]) and
op 15 serializes OrderedMap contents. The token is NOT deterministic (the
fingerprint carries performance.now/Math.random floats), so expect_result
asserts solve success + pass chain + the token's stable plaintext head
(expected_plain_prefix after XOR with plain_xor_key); no expected_token.
